card.name: Linking words before fluoroquinolone drug names
card.fires_on: The word "including" right after "Fluoroquinolones," and the "e.g.," before an antibiotic list such as gatifloxacin or moxifloxacin. It marks the spot where a specific quinolone name comes next.

modes.description: The word "including" follows the class name "Fluoroquinolones," just before a named drug.
